title: Google just launched their new AI video model Omni
description:
Google just launched their new AI video model Omni I was at IO last week and when it was first announced I wasnt too impressed I thought for texttovideo generation Seedance was still superior But then I realized the true power of the model is in native video editing To me this represents the future of video editing Now right now there are a lot of bottlenecks No 1080 native expect to be solved soon in Omni Pro Max 10 seconds generations Its relatively slow and expensive But in the future it will be very high resolution with immaculate detail and lightning quick generation time These models or similar will be available in your favorite video editors but a lot of people will choose to just edit natively conversationally in their superapp of choice What do you think of Omni google omni
Roberto Nickson
